# Veyvox 1.17.0

## A new name for this independently maintained fork

This release adopts **Veyvox**, with the maintainer-supplied double-V artwork,
regenerated desktop/tray/PWA icons and English/Brazilian Portuguese READMEs.
All 25 interface languages remain available. Juno's rules, cards, music and
Portuguese dubbing are unchanged.

Veyvox is derived from [the original Backspace](https://github.com/TheZwiss/backspace),
created by **Jannis Braun (TheZwiss)**. Thank you to Jannis and all original
contributors. This fork is maintained independently; this is not an official
upstream rename, release or endorsement.

## Upgrade without starting over

- Install over this community fork's existing installation. Internal profile,
  executable/bundle, app ID and updater-cache identities deliberately retain
  compatibility names. On macOS replace the existing `Backspace Fork.app` at
  its current path, rather than creating a second application.
- Existing sessions, connected instances, language/device/Juno preferences and
  server data stay under their existing storage names. A fresh instance defaults
  to Veyvox; an existing instance's chosen name is not changed.
- The new `window.veyvox` bridge shares the existing bounded implementation
  with the legacy alias. New clients retain old-shell fallback; old hosted
  clients still understand events emitted by the new shell.
- Both `veyvox://` and `backspace://` support strictly validated join/channel
  links. Older installed binaries do not gain new OS protocol registration
  just by loading a newer web client.
- Historical-profile migration refuses inaccessible/invalid profiles instead of
  silently opening an empty one. Cross-device migration stages a complete copy
  and retains the original safety copy.
- Linux refreshes only an existing, enabled, owned legacy autostart path. Missing,
  disabled and unrelated entries are not automatically overwritten or re-enabled.

For servers, update **from the existing installation directory**. Preserve
`.env`, secrets, Compose project/service identity and `data/`. The public image
channel stays `ghcr.io/bernardokcosta/backspace`; the service stays `backspace`.
Do not use `--remove-orphans`, create a second stack or regenerate credentials
as part of this rebrand. Take a backup before any update.

## Platform limits

Windows installers are not Authenticode-signed. Linux assets are unsigned.
macOS builds are ad-hoc signed, not notarized, and use manual downloads rather
than in-place Squirrel updates. Review the README and desktop security guide
for the relevant OS warnings and permissions. This release includes no native
iOS/Android app-store build; mobile uses the web/PWA client.

## Português (Brasil)

Este fork independente passa a se chamar **Veyvox**, com novos ícones e READMEs
em inglês e português brasileiro. Os 25 idiomas e todo o conteúdo do Juno são
preservados. Agradecemos a **Jannis Braun (TheZwiss)** e aos contribuidores do
Backspace original pela base do projeto, sem sugerir endosso ou afiliação.

Atualize a instalação existente, sem apagar perfis, recriar segredos ou abrir
outra stack. Os nomes técnicos antigos que preservam login, configurações,
instâncias, dados e atualizações continuam intencionalmente em uso. No macOS,
substitua o bundle no caminho atual. Faça backup antes de atualizar e consulte
o README em português para as instruções e limitações de cada plataforma.
